independentReview.notes: Every spoken sentence reviewed against canonical English short reader for clear newcomer meaning, source grounding, curiosity and emotional intent. Replaced abstract promotional commentary with concrete viewer-facing language. All eight sentences have a distinct intended response and explicit restrained TTS direction; fictional later outcomes remain withheld. This is editorial review, not audience testing or rendered-audio approval.

sentenceIntentions.text: A chatbot can explain a problem; an agent may take action on it.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Separate explaining a problem from acting on it
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Notice why agency changes the stakes

sentenceIntentions.text: AI Agents begins with a support request about a laboratory instrument that stopped uploading measurements.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Name the book through a broken laboratory upload
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Understand the concrete service setting immediately

sentenceIntentions.text: Following that ordinary incident reveals what changes when software starts choosing its next step.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Connect the ordinary incident to software choosing next steps
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Become curious about decisions behind the interface

sentenceIntentions.text: A database lookup, a proposed restart, and a closed ticket carry very different responsibilities.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Differentiate looking up, restarting and closing a case
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Recognize unequal consequences among helpful-looking actions

sentenceIntentions.text: The book follows goals through tool use, permissions, checks, and the decision to stop.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Show the organizational elements behind tool use
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Expect practical exploration of controlled autonomy

sentenceIntentions.text: It keeps returning to the gap between an impressive demonstration and dependable work.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Keep demonstration distinct from dependable work
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Question what must remain reliable after a successful demo

sentenceIntentions.text: Behind a helpful answer, you begin to see who acts, who checks, and who carries the risk.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Link the hidden steps to the reader's understanding
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Want to inspect responsibility rather than merely admire autonomy

sentenceIntentions.text: Begin with the missing measurements, and follow the decisions hidden behind a helpful answer.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Return to missing measurements as the reading doorway
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Follow a specific unresolved support case
